157-data-model.text: On-chain shapes, indices and invariants. No bodies.

the-leaf.text: Any other value bytes are refused before a proof is checked. The naming-era values — the representative name, the over marker — are not leaves.

request-field-appended.text: destination names where a minted active or terminal token goes and the inline datum the receiving output must carry (datum_hash empty for none). For Insert(0x00) the address is the refund address; the token goes to custody.

state-eight-fields-replaces-six.text: consumer_pin is deleted. All four policies are set at genesis and preserved by every Modify.

token-identity.text: Under each of the three policies the asset name is the registry key. Identity is (policy, key). A key recreated after Delete(0x01) carries the same identity.

the-approval.text: Minted under application_policy, quantity 1, asset name blake2b_256(edge ‖ key ‖ owner ‖ destination); edge one byte, the seven-admitted-edges row index (0 insertAbsent … 5 deleteActive). Carried by the request UTxO; recomputed by the cage; not burned at fold.
